title: The day-by-day visit charts tell their details only by colour, bar height and a mouse-hover note
what: The 30-day check-in bars on Visits and the training squares on a member page show each day's count or 'trained' only through bar height, a brighter colour for today, or an orange square. The words for each day sit in a hover note that a phone tap and a screen reader do not get, so those users only hear the short summary line.
expected: Each chart has a short spoken summary (or a hidden list of days) and today or a trained day is marked by more than colour.
who: owners and desk staff using a screen reader or a phone
how_often: every time the chart is read
fix_line: Give each chart a spoken summary and mark today or trained days with a shape or word, not only colour

title: No automatic accessibility check ever looks at Diet plans, Challenges, Gym timings, Busy machines or Entry machines
what: The automatic page check visits Visits, Enquiries, Expenses, Import, Help and a member page, but never opens Diet plans, Challenges, Gym timings, Busy machines or Entry machines, never opens any pop-up, and only looks in the dark look. Faults on those pages can ship unseen.
expected: Every page of the panel, its main pop-ups and the light look are checked automatically.
who: owners who rely on a screen reader or keyboard
fix_line: Add these pages, a few pop-ups and the light look to the automatic page check

items.reason: No clickable divs in these 14 files; buttons are 44px with row-specific screen reader names; risk bands, online/offline and money tiles carry words; muted text passes contrast in both looks. Faults: charts by colour and hover only, five pages never auto-checked, fixed pixel text sizes already reported. Largest phone font not checkable without a device.

No panel screenshot of these screens exists in docs; judged from code. Cancel membership, cancel receipt, withdraw diet plan, member photo, delete measurements and end challenge use the borderless text-look button already reported.

Thank-you 'Not now' keeps the button on the enquiry; closing Sell membership after Make member opens the member page where it can be sold. But diet plan, expense, enquiry, measurement and challenge forms lose all typing on close, same fault as already reported.
